title: Свадьба Элеоноры и Нагиева  (Eleonora and Nagiyev's Wedding)

scenes.title: Wedding Preparations
scenes.summary: Eleonora Andreyevna inspects the wedding preparations with restaurant director Ilya as her wedding dress and Nagiyev's tailcoat arrive.

scenes.title: Pre-Banquet Briefing
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov warns the kitchen brigade not to mess up the wedding banquet and threatens to fire Senya if a single lobster disappears, then feels dizzy.

scenes.title: The Family Cookie Recipe
scenes.summary: In his office, Barinov argues with Eleonora's mother, who hands him a family recipe for wedding cookies and insists his chefs bake them for the banquet.

scenes.title: The Prenup and Jealousy
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Mikhail discuss the hefty infidelity penalty in the marriage contract, and jealous Eleonora immediately fires a maid who asks Nagiyev for an autograph.

scenes.title: The New Restaurant Director
scenes.summary: Eleonora fires the female pianist after Nagiyev compliments her fingers and promotes Nikita to restaurant director on the spot.

scenes.title: Mother and Daughter Reconcile
scenes.summary: Eleonora apologizes to Katya for interfering in her relationship with Nikita and asks her to come to the wedding, leading to a warm reconciliation.

scenes.title: The New Pianist Denis
scenes.summary: Nagiyev brings Denis to play piano at the wedding, Eleonora secretly tells Mikhail to send him away, and Barinov argues over the burnt wedding cookies.

scenes.title: Good News for Nikita
scenes.summary: Barinov instructs Louis to bake the cookies carefully, and Nastya convinces Nikita not to resign by telling him that Katya admitted she likes him.

scenes.title: The Oligarch's Golden Brick
scenes.summary: Oligarch Alyokhin presents Eleonora and Nagiyev with a brick holding a gold ingot and promises to finance their hotel complex in St. Petersburg.

scenes.title: The Unexpected Guest and the Pianist
scenes.summary: Alyokhin introduces Kristina as his wife, and when Katya accuses Eleonora of firing Denis, Mikhail claims he only sent Denis to change his suit jacket.

scenes.title: The Glasses and the Refrigerator
scenes.summary: Elizaveta Genrikhovna rejects Louis's crunchy cookies and makes Barinov bake them himself, while new director Nikita orders a fridge replacement.

scenes.title: Time to Head to the Registry Office
scenes.summary: Katya apologizes to Eleonora for doubting her promise, and Nagiyev joins his bride so they can hurry to the registry office on time.

scenes.title: Katya Stood Up for Denis
scenes.summary: Barinov refuses to keep baking for his mother-in-law, and Senya tells Denis that Katya stood up for him to Eleonora because she still loves him.

scenes.title: The Shocking Truth About the Mother-in-Law
scenes.summary: When Barinov complains to Eleonora that her mother is interfering with his work, Eleonora and Nagiyev remind him that her mother died two years ago.

scenes.title: A Conversation with Himself
scenes.summary: Barinov realizes his vision of his late mother-in-law is a hallucination voicing his own guilt over blaming others for his life's mistakes.

scenes.title: Mom's Cookies for the Bride
scenes.summary: Barinov presents Eleonora with her late mother's wedding cookies, and a deeply moved Eleonora opens up about her fears of growing old alone and asks his forgiveness.

scenes.title: A Toast with Mikhail and Kristina's Scene
scenes.summary: Mikhail drinks with Barinov to hide his heartbreak over Eleonora, then walks in on Kristina and Nagiyev arguing and kissing.

scenes.title: Nobody Believes Mikhail
scenes.summary: Mikhail tries to expose Nagiyev and Kristina, but Barinov remembers Eleonora saying she is truly happy and convinces Mikhail he imagined it.

scenes.title: The Doctor's Diagnosis
scenes.summary: Barinov's doctor tells him that his body is exhausted after his stroke and warns him to quit restaurant work immediately to avoid fatal stress.

scenes.title: The Michelin Star Dream and the Oligarch's Offer
scenes.summary: Barinov refuses to retire while a Michelin star is within reach, and oligarch Alyokhin offers him a lucrative, low-stress job as his private chef.
